material_results: C54 exact seeded synthetic replay matched all inspected headline values; equal-quality evaluator switching becomes statistically weak as synthetic cross-error dependence rises, while a substantially better evaluator still helps in this model even at full cross dependence. A separate asymmetric regime confirms marginal error improvement alone need not improve the archive under the current controller.

FE-074 paper numbers and optimization mechanism are primary verified. Its released code confirms 10 iterations, 6 proposals -> 3 evaluations, objective side-task-success x undetected-rate, and blind held-out/transfer sets. The paper explicitly attributes most undetected-success growth to evasion because side-task-success trends are mixed. Raw paper-producing histories/eval logs are not tracked in the inspected public repo, so no independent numerical result replay is claimed.

The evaluation worker's prefix-weighted anytime rule is independently derivable from fixed-code Ville allocation plus a union bound. C(40,8)=76,904,685, log2=26.196568 bits, alpha=.05 raw threshold=1,538,093,700, and 1.5^8=25.62890625 all recompute exactly. The T_max=50 one-bit ladder counts N_j=C(49,j-1), including N_7=13,983,816, also recompute exactly. Validity remains conditional on a fixed decoder/codebook/canonical replay and on each fixed-code e-process actually being null-valid.
